title: US2 public Article beta replacement candidate awaits live exact-head proof
summary: Historical subjects 25e7626, 8e029c5, and 1e414d7 implement the bounded T034, T035, T037, T038, T040, and T041 candidate from main c39288f. Exact predecessor head 2bac1f8 passed Java, contracts, Docker, CodeQL, and Trivy but failed browser and dependency gates. The bounded remediation now passes actual local Chromium US1, US2, combined and full regression, direct Lighthouse budgets, workspace verification, bundle budgets, and a zero-vulnerability development audit. A replacement PR head still requires live CI, Security, mergeability, and review-thread read-back. T036 and T039 remain complete and preserved, while T056, T057+, Web3, deployment, and migrations remain out of scope.

claims.text: The authoritative base is main c39288f98279b939401302fe6c50376340db9c6a with T036 and T039 checked and the six selected US2 tasks unchecked.
Historical subject commit 5b03ee08b1c94b99d17ce086ea9aa5015a0c55a9 contains the tests-first acceptance and API contract baseline, not a current merge-gate receipt.

Historical backend subject 25e762640da558b205c16d810c151163148bced8 implements T034 and T035 with immutable v2 article snapshots, server-derived text and reading time, frozen contributors and media attribution, stable ETags, and snapshot navigation.

Historical reader subject 8e029c5409ab8e9387896062f31c370d55a29598 implements T037, T038, T040, and the reader portion of T041 with SSR-safe blocks, a trusted bounded p5 runtime, magazine reader UX, navigation, share, SEO, no-JS, accessibility, lifecycle, and performance gates.
Historical workflow subject 1e414d7c77ec1817fdd48390cdedea4e368856c8 requires every CI and Security job to check out and verify the observed PR source head.

Local feasible acceptance passed workspace verification with 80 web tests and eight creative-runtime tests, actual Chromium US1 3/3, US2 23/23, combined 26/26, full regression 30/30, two-URL three-run Lighthouse budgets, bundle and SSR gates, dependency audit, and independent review.

The candidate changes only the six selected task checkboxes; T036 and T039 stay checked, T056 stays unchecked with only package-relocation imports in its test file, and T057+, Web3, deployment, and migrations remain unchanged.

Exact predecessor head 2bac1f87e200442c773ca1de9dbd89b842630f6a failed browser acceptance and dependency audit while its Java, contract, Docker, CodeQL, and Trivy lanes passed; run IDs 31684079435 and 31684079408 are historical receipts only.

The browser, media-geometry, creative-owner, crawlability, compression, Lighthouse-runner, and vulnerable LHCI findings are remediated in the local replacement candidate and covered by actual Chromium, Lighthouse, unit, bundle, and audit evidence.

Replacement exact-head CI, Security, component, browser, mergeability, and review attribution must be read live for the observed PR head and recorded externally so a metadata commit cannot invalidate its own claim.
Local Java 21 execution remains unavailable; the predecessor Java gate passed, and the replacement head must independently repeat that P3 proof on GitHub.
Protected merge remains a human gate and is not implied by leaving a reviewable PR.
